title.suggested: Tom Allen Says Corbett Has the Speed to Beat Fitzsimmons

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic reported that Tom Allen, who saw the Sullivan-Corbett fight and was with Charlie Mitchell at Jacksonville, picked Corbett to beat Fitzsimmons, calling him the fastest big man he had ever seen.

metadata.notes: Page header reads The Republic: St. Louis, Mo., Sunday Morning, February 7, 1897, page 8, under the banner 'Veteran Boxers Give Their Views on the Fight.'

facts.fact: Allen witnessed the Sullivan-Corbett championship fight in New Orleans
Allen was with Charlie Mitchell at Jacksonville when Mitchell was beaten by Corbett
Allen said he had witnessed all of Fitzsimmons' fights in New Orleans
facts.quote: I have witnessed all of Fitz's fights in New Orleans.

facts.fact: Allen predicted Corbett would beat Fitzsimmons with his left and a blow to the stomach
facts.quote: Jim will bring out his left, block it and he will go for a smash into the lanky fellow's stomach that will wind his clock before many rounds have been fought.

facts.fact: Allen called Corbett the fastest big man he had ever seen in the ring
facts.quote: Corbett is the fastest big man I have ever seen in the ring, and has a left hand, the equal of which was never before produced.

notes: The end of the top quote ('will go for a smash into the lanky fellow's stomach ... before many rounds') is cut in the crop and was read from the page image. The rest of the interview (second and third columns) is cut off and was not reviewed.
